description: Source code for the 'Pick List' doctype in ERPNext, managing stock picking operations including validation, item location assignment, serialization, batch handling, and related document creation (Delivery Note, Stock Entry).

classes.name: PickList
classes.description: Main class representing the Pick List document, handling validation, item location setting, grouping, and serialization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the pick list, including quantity validation.

methods.name: before_save
methods.description: Prepares data before saving, such as setting item locations.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Performs serial number validation before submission.

methods.name: set_item_locations
methods.description: Assigns item locations based on availability and stock.

methods.name: aggregate_item_qty
methods.description: Aggregates quantities of similar items for the pick list.

methods.name: validate_for_qty
methods.description: Ensures the quantity for manufacturing purposes is greater than zero.

methods.name: group_similar_items
methods.description: Groups similar items to optimize pick list.
